about.title: About Restoration 24
text: Restoration and reconstruction under one roof. For more than 20 years we have helped homeowners and businesses recover from water, fire, mold and storm damage, and rebuild better than before.

Restoration 24 started in 2005 and grew out of helping families recover from contaminated floodwaters after Hurricane Katrina. Since then, our team has handled thousands of water, fire, mold, storm and biohazard jobs for homes, businesses and industrial properties.

Our mission is simple: provide fast, efficient and compassionate restoration, and take the stress off you. Because we are also licensed general contractors, the same team that stops the damage rebuilds your property, so you have one point of contact from the first call to the final walkthrough.
